notes.title: Puzzle game Mirrored Pawns challenges your spatial reasoning with opposite movements
notes.notes:
In the new game Mirrored Pawns from Firebelley (Sword Slinger, Cryptographer) it challenges your spatial reasoning as you simultaneously control two characters that move in opposite directions.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/03/puzzle-game-mirrored-pawns-challenges-your-spatial-reasoning-with-opposite-movements
